newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Education Mgmt rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Education Mgmt rated buy.

text.p: -- Chicago Corp on Wednesday said it initiated coverage of Education Management Corp with a buy rating.
-- Education Management is a proven leader in the market for post-secondary education, said Chicago Corp, adding that quarterly results in September were better than expected.

-- Chicago Corp said demographic and economic trends are expected to continue to provide growth opportunities for the company, which is one of the nation's largest for-profit providers of higher education.
-- Education Managmeent was trading at 18, off 1/8.
